export_to_sharepoint.description: Export what a Find staff email and chats step found, and put it in a SharePoint folder for the clerk: one Outlook data file (.pst) per person, Teams chats as readable transcripts, and a list of every item. Put it after IT's approval. An export can take hours: the run waits without holding anything up, and carries on when the files are ready.

find_staff_messages.description: Search the email and Teams chats of the staff a records request names, for the dates it asks about, and count what matches. Nothing is read or moved yet: the step says how many items, how big, and from how many people, so IT can approve the search before Export to SharePoint runs it. The search is kept in a Microsoft Purview case named after the request.
find_staff_messages.display_str_template: Find staff email and chats for {request_name}

mock_response.summary: 412 items (1.3 GB) from 3 of 3 people, sent or received January 1, 2026 to March 31, 2026, containing "parking garage". Plus 12 items Purview couldn't fully read, which the export includes.

parameters.description: The first day to search, as the request gives it.

parameters.description: The last day to search, included.

parameters.description: Words or phrases, one per line. Finds messages that contain any of them. Leave empty to find everything in the dates.
